app.name: Totalvizibil
app.tagline: Where local businesses get built and found

feed.title: Find a local business you can trust
feed.lead: Browse active businesses near you — no account needed. Businesses show while their campaign is funded; order reflects relevance, quality and freshness.

create.headline: Come with an idea. Leave with a business.
create.lead: Choose how much you want to steer. The rest of this flow is being redesigned.
create.easyText: A few quick answers and the assistant does the rest. Fast and simple.
create.advancedText: Control branding, tone, sections, SEO and more for a tailored result.
create.nextText: We're rethinking what happens after this choice — it isn't wired up yet.
create.registerLaterNote: No sign-up required to start — you'll register only to save and publish.

studio.title: Let's build your website
studio.previewEmpty: Your website appears here as you answer the assistant.
studio.turnsLeft: {n} messages left on the free plan
studio.loadError: Couldn't load the draft. Reload the page and try again.
studio.doneText: We saved it as a draft. The location step comes next.
studio.capTitle: You've reached the free plan limit
studio.capText: The starter website is ready. Continue with the location to publish it in the feed.
studio.locationSoon: The “Location” step (city + radius on a map) arrives in the next milestone.

msg.opening: Hi! I'm the Totalvizibil assistant and I'll build you a one-page website. Tell us what your business does so we can build your site.
msg.askCity: Which city are you in, or what area do you serve?
msg.askServices: List 3–5 main services, separated by commas.
msg.askContact: A phone number and an email for contact? (you can type “skip”)
msg.generated: I've built the first version of your website — you can see it on the left.
msg.askRefine: Want the tone friendlier, more professional, premium, calm or bold? Type “done” if it looks good.
msg.done: Done! Your starter website is saved as a draft. The next step is the location.
msg.cap: You've used all the messages included in the free plan. You can continue with the next steps.
msg.alreadyDone: The starter website is already finished. Move on to the location step.

location.title: Where do you work?
location.lead: Pick your city and the radius you cover. This area decides where your business can appear in the feed.
location.mapHint: Click the map to move the exact point.
location.feedNote: You appear in the feed for searches within this area.
location.categoryHint: Pick the exact niche of your services — it is how customers find you in the feed.

claim.title: Create your account
claim.lead: Save “{business}” and publish it when you're ready.
claim.saveNote: Your website and location are saved to your account automatically.
claim.additionalFee: A second business (and beyond) costs {credits} credits.
claim.notEnough: Not enough in that wallet ({credits} credits needed).

err.additional_business_payment_required: You already have a business — a second one costs credits. Pick a wallet.
err.insufficient_credits: Not enough credits in the chosen wallet.
err.cannot_pay_from_that_company: You can't pay from that wallet.
err.draft_already_claimed: This draft has already been used.
err.category_required: Choose the business category before continuing.

claim.walletBalance: You have {credits} credits in your wallet.

dashboard.taskBudgetTitle: Set a campaign budget to publish your website in the feed
dashboard.taskBudgetText: Your website is saved as a draft. To appear in the feed it needs a campaign budget.
dashboard.taskBudgetDone: Your campaign is live — your business appears in the feed.
dashboard.noBusinessText: Build your business with the AI assistant and come back here.
dashboard.taskAdvancedText: Pay for the advanced plan from your wallet to unlock the full builder.
dashboard.taskLocationTitle: Set the area you appear in the feed
dashboard.taskLocationText: Pick your city and radius on the map — it decides where your business can show up.
dashboard.deleteText: Permanently removes the business, its website and campaign. Your wallet stays.
dashboard.deleteConfirmText: "{name}", its website and campaign are permanently deleted. Your wallet credits are kept. This cannot be undone.
dashboard.walletShared: Shared wallet across all your businesses.

campaign.title: Budget & CPC
campaign.liveNote: Your campaign is live. Your business appears in the feed.
campaign.depletedNote: Not enough credits — the campaign stopped. Top up your wallet to resume it.
campaign.cpcInvalid: CPC must be between 0.05 and the daily budget.
campaign.appearFirstHint: Recommended budget and CPC for a shot at the top of the feed.
campaign.needCredits: You need {need} credits in the wallet · balance: {balance}

err.insufficient_credits: Not enough balance for the daily budget. Add credits.

campaign.pausedNote: The campaign is stopped. Re-activate it to show in the feed again.
campaign.editStopsNote: Saving changes stops the campaign until you re-activate it.

wallet.title: Wallet & Credits
wallet.devNote: Dev mode — no real payment is processed. Confirm to add the credits.
wallet.prepaidNote: The wallet is prepaid. The balance can never go negative.
wallet.mainNote: One wallet for every business you own.

auth.registerSubtitle: A few seconds and your account is ready.
auth.name: Your name
auth.totpSubtitle: Two-factor is on for this account.
auth.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.totpInvalid: That code is not valid. Try the current one.
auth.genericError: We couldn't process that. Check your details and try again.

reset.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link.
reset.sentText: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
reset.devNote: Dev mode — no email is sent, use this link:
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Set a new password for your account.
reset.noToken: This link is missing its token. Request a new reset email.
reset.doneText: Password updated. Redirecting to log in…

account.title: Account & security
account.emailChangeHint: Confirm your password to change your email
account.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.changePasswordNote: You stay signed in on this device; other sessions are signed out.
account.twoFaNote: Add a one-time code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
account.twoFaScan: Scan this with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually:

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.selfStatusHint: You can't suspend your own account
admin.setPasswordNote: The user is signed out everywhere and must use the new password.
admin.noCompanies: This user isn't a member of any company.
admin.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.notFoundText: The address you requested doesn't exist or has moved.

advanced.title: A complex, AI-built website
advanced.lead: More pages, a design of your choice, a portfolio and sections — built step by step with the assistant.
advanced.priceNote: Paid from your wallet after you create an account, before you use the builder.

perk.design: Colour palette and typography of your choice

advanced.flowNote: Next: account → pay for the plan → builder → location → campaign.

builder.title: Website Builder
builder.lockText: Pay once from your wallet to unlock the full builder.
builder.doneText: Continue with the location and campaign to publish it.

err.not_an_advanced_website: This website is not on the advanced plan.

msg.opening: Hi! I'm the Totalvizibil assistant and I'll build you a complex website. Tell us what your business does.
msg.askName: Great. What is the business called?
msg.askCity: Which city are you in, or what area do you serve?
msg.askServices: List your main services, separated by commas.
msg.askAudience: Who are your ideal clients? (you can skip)
msg.askTone: What tone — professional, friendly, premium, calm or bold?
msg.askPages: Which pages do you want? e.g. about, services, portfolio, contact (or "all")
msg.askDesign: Which colour palette — blue, green, gold, grey or pink?
msg.askTypography: Which typography style — modern (grotesk), classic (serif) or technical (mono)?
msg.askContact: A phone number and an email for contact?
msg.generated: I've built the multi-page website — you can see it on the left.
msg.askRefine: Want me to adjust the colour, typography or tone? Type "done" if it looks good.
msg.done: Done! The website is saved. The next step is the location.
msg.alreadyDone: The website is already finished. Move on to the location step.

site.formError: Couldn't send. Check your details and try again.
site.formThanks: Thanks! The business will get back to you soon.

leads.title: Requests
leads.statAvgHint: Average time until you marked a reply. Used in feed ranking.
leads.emptyHint: Contact-form messages and call taps from your site show up here.
leads.deleteConfirmText: The request is permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

analytics.intro: Real data from your ad and site: billed clicks, calls, form messages and how fast you reply. The visibility score sets your feed order.
